data.situation:
A proposal displayed beside the old road asked for a wider entrance. Ruth traced the proposed boundary with her finger. If all the shrubs were removed, the work could destroy habitats. Jo compared it with a plan for reforestation projects elsewhere in the region. New trees would take time to grow; they would not instantly replace every lost relationship. In another folder, a reintroduction proposal considered returning an animal to an area where it no longer lived. Local disappearance was different from global extinction. Maya: Has that animal reached extinction?
Ruth: It has disappeared from this area. That does not tell us its worldwide status.
Jo: Will reintroduction definitely succeed?
Ruth: The proposal must consider the habitat and possible risks first.

readingBlocks.en: A proposal displayed beside the old road asked for a wider entrance. Ruth traced the proposed boundary with her finger. If all the shrubs were removed, the work could destroy habitats. Jo compared it with a plan for reforestation projects elsewhere in the region. New trees would take time to grow; they would not instantly replace every lost relationship. In another folder, a reintroduction proposal considered returning an animal to an area where it no longer lived. Local disappearance was different from global extinction.
readingBlocks.zh: 旧路旁提案请求拓宽入口。露丝用手指划过拟定边界。若清除所有灌木，施工可能破坏栖息地。乔把它与该地区其他地方的重新造林项目比较。新树需要时间成长，不能立刻替代失去的所有关系。另一个夹子里，放归提案考虑让动物回到已不再生活的地区。本地消失与全球灭绝不同。

readingBlocks.en:

Jo: Will reintroduction definitely succeed?

readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：那种动物已经灭绝了吗？
露丝：它从这个地区消失了，这不能说明全球状态。
乔：放归肯定能成功吗？
露丝：提案必须先考虑栖息地和可能风险。
